description: This file defines a Go package for Kubernetes client apply configurations related to ResourceQuota objects, including functions for constructing, extracting, and modifying declarative configurations for resource quotas.

classes.name: ResourceQuotaApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A declarative configuration for Kubernetes ResourceQuota, including metadata, spec, and status fields, with methods for building and modifying the configuration.

methods.name: ResourceQuota
methods.description: Constructs a new ResourceQuotaApplyConfiguration with specified name and namespace, setting kind and apiVersion.

methods.name: ExtractResourceQuotaFrom
methods.description: Extracts the applied configuration owned by a specific field manager from a ResourceQuota object, optionally for a subresource.

methods.name: ExtractResourceQuota
methods.description: Extracts the applied configuration owned by a specific field manager from a ResourceQuota object.

methods.name: ExtractResourceQuotaStatus
methods.description: Extracts the applied configuration for the status subresource of a ResourceQuota.
